{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv("/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv")

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders from LOYAL customers
df_loyal_completed = df[(df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (df['status'] == 'completed')]

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = df_loyal_completed['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Check for QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
qa_orders = df_loyal_completed[df_loyal_completed['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]

# Print results
mean_revenue, len(qa_orders), df_loyal_completed['revenue_clean'].describe()"}
